Here's the design I'm going for:

The keeper (`npc/keeper`) currently has two declared roles in the seed — warding the stagfolk against needless migration, and witnessing ashkar's rumblings — but no machine of its own. A machine that captures both responsibilities, plus a "retire" terminal, lets the keeper's role evolve meaningfully: a warding transition that *also* mints a brand-new warding-token node and binds it to the keeper; a witnessing transition that records which eruption was witnessed; a retirement path that transfers the warding-token to a successor (also a freshly-named param, so it's a fresh node at fire time); and a degraded "falling" terminal reached only when the keeper is fired without a valid successor.

The minting happens via the general effect form: `$successor \`carries\` self` and `$successor \`wardedBy\` $token` bring both a new keeper-node and a new token-node into the world the moment the transition fires with concrete bindings, exercising the open-world minting behavior SURFACE.md documents.

```
machine npc/keeper
  states
    onDuty
    wardbound
    retired
    fallen

  transition takeWard(token, ward)
    onDuty -> wardbound
    guard self `carries` $token
    assert $token `carries` $ward
    assert $ward `witnessedBy` self
    assert wardbound

  transition witnessEruption(eruption)
    wardbound -> wardbound
    guard self `witnessedBy` self `at` $eruption
    assert self `witnessedBy` $eruption
    retract self `witnessedBy` self `at` $eruption

  transition retire(successor, token)
    wardbound -> retired
    guard $successor `belongsTo` self
    assert $successor `carries` $token
    assert $successor `wardedBy` self
    assert retired
    retract wardbound

  transition fall()
    onDuty -> fallen
    assert fallen

  transition redeem(token)
    fallen -> wardbound
    guard $token `carries` self
    assert wardbound
    retract fallen
```

```dmml
machine mine/ninefathom
  states
    undug
    active
    flooded
    exhausted
    sealed
    haunted

  transition dig(digger)
    undug -> active
    guard $digger `worksAt` self
    assert $digger `masters` path/bronzework
    assert active

  transition flood()
    active -> flooded
    guard mountain/ashkar `erupts` self
    assert flooded
    retract active
    assert mountain/ashkar `witnessedBy` self

  transition pump(engineer)
    flooded -> active
    guard $engineer `masters` path/bronzework
    assert active
    retract flooded
    assert $engineer `apprenticesUnder` path/bronzework

  transition exhaust()
    active -> exhausted
    assert exhausted
    retract active
    assert self `carries` "rich_ore_stockpile"

  transition seal(warden)
    exhausted -> sealed
    guard $warden `masters` path/stonemasonry
    assert sealed
    retract exhausted
    assert $warden `wardsBy` self

  transition haunt(spirit)
    sealed -> haunted
    guard not self `witnessedBy` npc/keeper
    assert haunted
    retract sealed
    assert $spirit `belongs_to` self
    assert self `carries` "restless_spirit"

  transition purge(priest)
    haunted -> sealed
    guard $priest `masters` path/greenlore
    assert sealed
    retract haunted
    retract $spirit `belongs_to` self
    retract self `carries` "restless_spirit"
```
